test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Propensity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling is **Propensity**.
 
• The word **"propensity" **refers to **a natural inclination or tendency to behave in a particular way or to adopt a particular attitude or belief.** It suggests a strong disposition or proclivity toward a certain action or behavior.
 
• Here is an example of how **"propensity" **can be used in a sentence:
 
 
• "She has a **propensity **for taking risks." This sentence suggests that the person being described tends to take risks or engage in activities that are potentially dangerous.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The correct spelling is **Constituency**. The meaning of Constituency is Voting area.
 
• The correct spelling is** Demolish**. The meaning of **Demolish** is **Destroy and Annihilate**.
 
• The correct spelling is **Patronise**. The meaning of **Patronise **is **Favour**.
